ITBA is one of the leading universities in Engineering and Technology in Latin America, and Buenos Aires is among the most attractive cities for international students across the region.

B1 level in Spanish required. You must have studied roughly 2 years in university level at the time of applying.

How to prove your language skills

B2 level in English required in addition to Spanish B1 if you plan to take some courses in English.

ITBA fact sheet 2025,
ITBA Fact Sheet 2026

Studies and making your study plan

You can choose courses from different fields at ITBA. At undergraduate level (Bachelor's), there are study programmes of a five-year duration, equivalent to a European Master:

  • Business Administration
  • Business and Social Analytics
  • Bioengineering
  • Chemical Engineering
  • Software Engineering
  • Electronic Engineering
  • Industrial Engineering
  • Mechanical Engineering
  • Naval Architecture
  • Petroleum Engineering
  • Civil Engineering

In the engineering programmes, the 4th and 5th years are equivalent to Master year 1 and Master year 2 in the European system.

ITBA offers courses in both Spanish and English. In Spanish courses, international students may choose to get the bibliography in English and prepare for exams in English (English friendly). It is highly recommended that only students who can study in Spanish if required apply for this destination. Students are also welcome to use English in the class, even if the language of instruction is Spanish.

24 creditos is equivalent to 30 ECTS credits and 19 creditos is equivalent to 24 ECTS. Each ITBA credit corresponds to 17 hours of class and 8,5 hours of homework per semester.
Thus, the equivalence coefficients between the different systems would be: ITBA/UE = 24/30 = 0.8 ITBA credits are equivalent to 1 ECTS credits, and vice versa: EU/ITBA = 30/24 = 1,250 ECTS credits are equivalent to 1 ITBA credit.

The courses from the “ciclo profesional” are equivalent to Aalto master level courses.

Application information

The student must first be nominated by the home university. Only students selected by Aalto will complete host university's own application. Further instructions will be sent to the nominated students.
Please note that this university is located outside EU/EEA area in a country where data protection regulation may not be on the level required by the EU’s General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
